findings: The surface-mask B channel is remapped to 0.35 + 0.65*B before multiplying the band, so black does not strictly disallow the new highlight.
The new hair highlight uses the head-axis projected tangent approximation, a half vector, exponent, mask modulation and strength.
The preceding calibrated illumination factor is not wired into the generated hair-highlight strength in this source section.
B is a source-RGB-brightness-derived painted-highlight candidate, not an original artist-authored specular allowance map.
Existing hair exponent is 44; this study does not change the preset.

proposed_validation.hypothesis: An independent pre-exponent offset can reshape the generated band while a post-response allowance strictly removes it in selected UV regions.
proposed_validation.control: Original head/light/view directions, exponent, gain and existing mask modulation are fixed.
proposed_validation.bypass: k=0 for offset; M=1 for new allowance
acceptance: Strict-zero allowance produces zero for this generated highlight branch.
Offset-only changes can be traced in upstream scalar previews.
No new UV seam or temporal flicker across fixed-light head turns, moving-key tests and camera orbit.
proposed_validation.limits: No claim of full tangent transfer, no changes to the base MMD color or existing authored specular appearance.

proposed_validation.hypothesis: An optional intensity gate can make the new hair band participate in designed light/shadow regions.
proposed_validation.input_semantics: Existing calibrated combined-illumination response F, explicitly not isolated shadow visibility
acceptance: Only the generated hair-highlight branch is affected.
F and ungated/gated highlight outputs explain the difference.
Fill-light sensitivity is recorded and not misreported as pure visibility.
The gate remains optional if it erases useful dark-region hair structure or becomes unstable.
proposed_validation.limits: Directional diffuse darkness and true light occlusion are different; this is an art policy, not a physically complete specular visibility model.

promotion.reason: No implementation, same-frame render, dynamic test or user art approval was obtained by this study.
